notes.title: Goofy Goober Simulator v1.0.2 patch notes
notes.notes:
- Death screen is more clear
- Bosses spawn sooner after reaching the threshold (Used to be 12.3 seconds, now 8.3)
- Infamous boss not spawning bug fixed (Explanation: If enemy cap was reached new enemies including bosses just wouldn't spawn)
- minor issue of death jingle not playing fixed
- "WARNING" sound is now affected by the SFX slider
- Snowmonster boss hp nerfed: 75 -> 50
- Buying weapons autosaves
- spinning boss indicator functions better
- Nerfed the Drone and Shield item's passive damage to not overpower your actual weapons

notes.title: Goofy Goober Simulator - Halloween Progress Update
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween, goobers. 
GGS is still, albeit slow, still under development.

Outside of the store page, we haven't really shared much about what GGS is about, so here's a rundown:

 Goofy Goober Simulator (We'll refer to it as GGS Classic) was a small top down one-screen shooter filled entirely with placeholder art. Our lead programmer found it funny, and tinkered with it to be a bit larger scale, which became the first build of GGS.
 GGS has gone through, what, roughly 5 distinct major builds so far, with the steam release being the latest. This build is hopefully close to the true potential of the original GGS classic, while remaining in its original engine. That original engine is, uh, Turbowarp*.
 While Turbowarp is *excellent*, especially in its modding capabilities, it's MUCH harder to make something compared to Unity or Unreal, leading to a much lower scope than originally planned (one previous build was a objective based shooter closer to DOOM, but that quickly fell through.)
 To stay true to its roots, we will be remaining in Turbowarp for the rest of GGS's lifetime. Don't get your hopes up, lol.
 Oh, and this is a rage game. this is going to be difficult. good luck.

This is, at the end of the day, a passion project, and thus isn't a full priority, BUT we've still been cooking up some features!

Since the store page was set up, we've...

 Finished the level route, start to finish
 Ported features from the original GGS Classic
 Added a handful of weapons and items
 Filled (almost) every level with a fair variety of Little Guys that want to bite your hand off
 Finished... some kind of plot...
 Worked on polishing as much as we can to brush off the rougher edges
 Implemented Steam Achievements


it's certainly something. we hope you all call this game "something" too. in fact, one could even call this game "really Something".

.....When's this coming out? Uh expect sometime around
EARLY APRIL 2025
Count your stars until then. Stay... Goofy? Spooky? something like that. I still don't know if there's gonna be a fishing minigame yet...

(*Firebox is not affiliated with Scratch, the Scratch Team, the Scratch Foundation, or the TurboWarp team. This wouldn't be here without them, though.)
